canonical_statement: The report describes abacavir-associated abnormal liver function tests in an HLA B*5701-negative woman on a stable nevirapine regimen and examines reasons for abacavir discontinuation among patients receiving abacavir/lamivudine/nevirapine.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We also investigated the reasons for abacavir discontinuation in a cohort of patients treated with abacavir-lamivudine-nevirapine.

canonical_statement: The index case was a 33-year-old woman with HIV who was HLA B*5701-negative, negative for hepatitis viruses, and had previously normal transaminases.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: She tested negative for HLA B*5701 and hepatitis viruses. Her transaminases levels had always been normal along her antiretroviral treatment.

population.label: 33-year-old woman with HIV, HLA B*5701-negative, negative hepatitis-virus testing and previously normal transaminases

canonical_statement: After seven years on tenofovir/emtricitabine/nevirapine, the index patient was switched to abacavir/lamivudine/nevirapine to avoid long-term tenofovir toxicity.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 33-year-old woman was switched from tenofovir/emtricitabine/NVP to ABC/lamivudine/NVP after seven years on initial treatment to avoid tenofovir related long-term toxicity.

exposures.details: Started after switching from tenofovir/emtricitabine/nevirapine; doses and route were not reported.

canonical_statement: The authors characterize abacavir-induced liver injury in HLA B*5701-negative patients as uncommon but clinically relevant.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Here, we confirm these findings by documenting that in our cohort ABC-related hepatotoxicity was an uncommon, but clinically relevant event.

canonical_statement: The authors consider a pharmacokinetic abacavir-nevirapine interaction unlikely because abacavir is not metabolized by cytochrome enzymes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A pharmacokinetic drug-to-drug interaction between ABC and NVP is unlikely because ABC is not metabolized by cytochromial enzymes.

canonical_statement: The authors state that very limited and scanty data were available on both the safety and efficacy of the abacavir/lamivudine/nevirapine combination.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: very limited and scanty data are available not only on the safety but also on the efficacy ABC/lamivudine/NVP combination

canonical_statement: The authors suggest that some virologic failures attributed to the abacavir-containing regimen may have been substantially influenced by patients' previous antiretroviral regimens.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: some of the virologic failures apparently observed with ABC may have been significantly influenced by previous antiretroviral regimens.

canonical_statement: The authors conclude that clinicians should remain alert for signs of hepatitis in patients treated with abacavir.

canonical_statement: The authors conclude that abacavir/lamivudine/nevirapine should be considered as a simplification option only in patients not previously treated with suboptimal antiretroviral regimens.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: consider the efficacy of ABC/lamivudine/NVP combination as a simplification option only in patients not previously treated with suboptimal antiretroviral regimens.
